scenario.question: What is the highest precision reported for the article-entity suggestion stage?

qa.feedback: Correct and precise. arXiv:1703.10344 (Fetahu et al., 2017) abstract states: 'We achieve a high precision value of up to 93% in the article-entity suggestion stage and upto 84% for the article-section placement.'
